booking.title: Book Your Room
booking.universityFallback: Select a university suggestion or enter your university name.
booking.depositNote: The deposit is credited toward your accommodation rent, not added on top. Remaining rent follows the residence’s payment schedule.
booking.term1: The booking deposit is determined by Edmovinn administrators and forms part of your total accommodation rent. It is not an additional fee and is deducted from the balance payable to the residence.
booking.term2: Payment does not immediately confirm the booking. Final room availability is checked after payment is confirmed. Your booking remains Pending Confirmation until the selected room is approved.
booking.term3: If the selected room cannot be confirmed by the residence, the full booking deposit will be refunded. Refund progress will be shown in your student account; processing times depend on the payment method.
booking.term4: Cancellation and refund conditions are governed by the applicable booking policy and Turkish law. Any mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected. Contact Edmovinn for the policy applicable to your booking before making payment.
booking.term5: The remaining accommodation rent is paid according to the residence’s payment schedule and contract terms. There are no additional booking fees, platform fees or credit card installment options in this booking flow.
booking.term6: The accommodation contract and check-in procedures are completed with the residence. The student must satisfy the residence’s enrollment, identification and check-in requirements. Booking progress, residence updates and contract status are available in the student account.
